principles: Destructive cleanup must use canonical git worktree roots, never raw process.cwd().
DONE metadata must be committed from the story worktree root before merge.
Regression coverage must model the nested cwd that triggered SimCell B-e101.
drivers: SimCell B-e101 left a dirty registered worktree and undeleted branch after a nominal DONE.
The current bug can delete a child project directory while leaving the actual worktree alive.
The fix touches DONE gate cleanup, so fail-closed safety matters more than cosmetic output.

options.name: A: Canonicalize worktree root in story_advance DONE
pros: Small focused fix in the failing lifecycle path
Can be regression tested with nested cwd
cons: Still relies on shell git probes in story-advance.ts

options.name: B: Require DONE only from worktree root
cons: Regresses normal project workflows where agents work inside package subdirectories
Would turn a recoverable path issue into user friction

options.name: C: Only improve doctor repair cleanup
pros: Could clean existing leftovers after the fact
cons: Does not prevent child directory rm or stale TEST metadata during DONE
Leaves scary fatal warnings in the success path

chosen: A: Canonicalize worktree root in story_advance DONE
rationale: Choose A because it fixes the actual dangerous target selection while preserving the useful ability to run Koala from nested project directories. DONE cleanup should be robust to cwd location inside the worktree.

preMortem.scenario: Canonicalization picks main root instead of story worktree root
preMortem.trigger: git rev-parse command run from main or detached context
preMortem.consequence: DONE auto-merge skipped or tries to clean the wrong root
preMortem.mitigation: Only auto-merge when detected branch starts with story/ and show-toplevel differs from mainRepoRoot; regression asserts target path equals .worktrees/B-xxx.

preMortem.scenario: Regression test passes without exercising nested cwd
preMortem.trigger: Test runs story_advance DONE from worktree root only
preMortem.mitigation: Test must run the CLI/handler from a nested PVSC-like subdirectory and assert no removal target contains /PVSC.

preMortem.scenario: Safety guard blocks valid cleanup after successful merge
preMortem.trigger: Registered worktree detection compares unnormalized paths
preMortem.consequence: DONE succeeds but leaves worktree/branch residue
preMortem.mitigation: Normalize paths with resolve/realpath-style slash normalization and assert git worktree list no longer contains the story path.
